description.value: Lillooet's Cookhouse Restaurant is a full-service diner on Main Street in Lillooet serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner with an extensive scratch menu. The kitchen offers a wide range of eggs benedicts, omelettes, wraps, and house-made pancakes — solid refuelling territory for cyclists on the Duffy Lake Road or the Fraser Canyon routes. The links page references local events including the Route 99 Cruz-In, suggesting the restaurant is embedded in the local touring and road-trip community.
